final: WITH group_stats AS (SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.healtheval AS health_status, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_minute, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_minute) AS mean_group_average FROM group_stats) SELECT g.site_code, g.health_status, g.avg_gb_per_minute, g.scan_count, g.avg_gb_per_minute - o.mean_group_average AS amount_above_mean FROM group_stats AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_group_average IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_gb_per_minute > o.mean_group_average ORDER BY amount_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
